sources.title: Snigirevsky et al.2025 Two new reconstructions of Archaeopteris trees
sources.notes: Primary full text read, particularly pp41–44 and Fig9. Actual Fig9 pixels inspected: published low-tree reconstruction has broad paddle leaves, branching woody trunk and crown. It is a copyrighted reconstruction, NOT a complete fossil. Authors explicitly retain copyright to Figs9/10. Consult-only, no source pixels/meshes incorporated or redistributed.
